integrity.computational_role: A standard-library script checks the rational polynomial integrals and resulting coefficients; it does not replace the analytic proof or certify nearest-zero localization.
integrity.priority_limit: Targeted indexed searches and inspection of the primary full text found no explicit statement of the \(n^{-8}\) coefficient; unindexed overlap remains possible.
integrity.proof_basis: Uniform radial-function expansion, exact area cancellation, Bessel derivative identities, exact rational polynomial integration, and the cited nearest-zero localization theorem.

scientific_limitations: The result is asymptotic for centered regular \(2n\)-gons of area \(\pi\); no explicit uniform constant for the \(O(n^{-10})\) remainder is claimed.
The result does not settle whether the regular dodecagon maximizes the Fourier-zero distance among all centrally symmetric planar convex bodies.
The polynomial moment coefficients are checked exactly, while nearest-zero localization is taken from the cited primary theorem.
title: Exact \(n^{-8}\) term in the Fourier-zero asymptotics of regular polygons
